Subject: Marketplace launch handoff: ACE registration checklist & PDM/PSM intro

Hi Samira / Diego —

Thanks for the meeting yesterday. Per our discussion, we want to get ACE registration started for the Acme Retail listing and make sure the internal PDM/PSM handoff is clean so there are no delays during listing validation. Attaching the checklist and a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

High-level asks:
- Samira: can you confirm the ACE record owner and the next available slot for a PDM intake call?
- Acme: can you confirm the expected launch window (dates) and the primary procurement contact for paperwork?
- Redwood: Vanessa will own the MAP updates and Marissa will lead security questionnaire responses.

Attachments: ACE-registration-checklist.pdf (checklist + required artifacts), RWI-Acme-MAP.xlsx (draft MAP)

Proposed timeline (subject to PDM availability):
- 4/9–4/12: PDM intake + documentation submission
- 4/13–4/20: Marketplace listing prep + security review
- 4/21: ACE submission

If we can lock the PDM intake for next week, I’ll schedule a quick sync to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace launch handoff: ACE registration checklist & PDM/PSM intro

Thanks Markus — nice summary and thanks for the attachments.

Quick notes:
- PDM intake: I can do a 30-minute intake on Tue 4/13 at 9:30am PT. I’ve cc’d Jordan (PSM) who will be the day-to-day touch for listing enablement.
- ACE owner: I recommend listing the PDM as the primary owner and Redwood contacts (Markus / Vanessa) as co-owners to keep notifications flowing to you.
- Documentation: The checklist looks good. For SOC/TIA evidence we usually need the latest report and a short data-flow diagram. If you can add that to the MAP tab "Security Artifacts" we’ll be able to move faster.

Jordan, can you confirm capacity to support a 4/13 intake and whether you prefer a separate PSM prep call with Acme procurement?

Best,

2) Any standard term redlines we should expect from AWS marketplace contracts? Our procurement team (procurement@acmeretail.com) is on copy.
